UNFOLDING CASE STUDY: OXYGENATION

The nurse cares for a 78-year-old female admitted to the medical intensive care unit in respiratory distress.

Nurses' Notes

0900. Client was admitted to the ICU in respiratory distress after minimal response to high flow oxygen for a pulse oximeter reading of 83% in room air. Crackles heard bilaterally in lower lobes with diminished breath sounds in right middle lobe; S1S2 auscultated; bowel sounds positive in all 4 quadrants; skin warm dry and intact. VS T 99.8F(37.7C); HR Laboratory Répón8/90; pulse oximeter is 87% on 100% non-rebreather; pain-0/10.

Lab ABG pH ABG POZ ABG PCO2 ABG HCO3 WBC Platelets Potassium (serum) Sodium (serum) Magnesium Blood culture Urine culture Sputum culture

Results 7.2 75 mm Hg 51 mm Hg 28 mEq/L 35,000 cells/mm3 250,000/ mm 4.0 mEq/L 140 mEq/L 1.5 mEq/L Gram negative cocci pending pending

Reference range 7.35-7.45 75-100 mm Hg 35-45 mmHg 22-26 mEq/L 4.5 - 10.5 x 103 cells/mm3 140,000 to 450,000/ mm3 3.5 to 5 mEq/L 135 to 145 mEq/L 1.5 to 2.1 mEg/L negative negative negative
